candidate.definition_en: Used to refer to two or more people or things previously mentioned.

senses.definition_en: Used to refer to two or more people or things previously mentioned.
senses.definition_ar: يُستخدم للإشارة إلى شخصين أو أكثر أو أشياء ذُكرت من قبل (هم / هن).
examples: My friends are here, and they want to meet you.
Where are the keys? I think they are on the table.
The children were tired, so they went to bed.
